labels.conjecture: labelled conjecture/extrapolated/[NUM] in the repo; NOT usable in the proof

labels.blocked_only_flag: nodes may carry "blocked_only": true — the node's OWN work is done (its statement/composition written or proved) and it is open solely because a dependency is open; rendered with a dashed outline
